_meta.description: Sparse coverage overrides for the curated Earnings Intelligence dataset. Only symbols with curated research beyond the default appear here. The authoritative stock list is SUPPORTED_STOCKS in backend/utils/constants.js -- CuratedEarningsIntelligenceService merges that list with this file at load time, so every supported stock always resolves to a coverage record (RESEARCH_PENDING when absent here) without this file needing to duplicate all ~150 symbols by hand.

companies.notes: Phase 4F evidence-integrity audit (2026-09-19): of the 3 curated promise/outcome pairs, 2 (attrition comfort-range vs FY25 actual; international-revenue directional outlook vs Q2 FY26 actual) were re-verified against REAL, newly re-ingested primary-source PDF text (exact excerpt and page number confirmed for both promise and outcome) and remain public. The third (operating-margin aspiration vs FY26 actual, TCS-FY2026-001) was QUARANTINED: neither its promise nor outcome source URL (both on tcs.com) is currently fetchable through any supported legitimate channel (live HTTP 403, Cloudflare-blocked), so the claim could not be re-confirmed against real stored text -- see evidenceIntegrity on that record for the full reason. resolvedPromiseCount/verifiedPromiseCount below reflect only publicly-visible records; the Faith Score is correctly null (< 3 resolved verified promises) until a fetchable primary source is found for the quarantined record or a new one is added. Coverage remains intentionally PARTIAL, not COMPLETE -- only a small sample of TCS's many quarterly commitments has been curated so far.
